description: This Dart source file defines the BookService class, which provides functionalities for searching books, obtaining detailed book information, fetching chapter content, managing downloads, and poll-based status updates within a Kindle clone frontend application. It interacts with a backend API via the ApiClient singleton and includes internal caching for chapter content.

classes.name: BookService
classes.description: Service providing book discovery and details via backend API with normalization, caching of chapters, and resilient polling.

methods.name: searchBooks
methods.description: Search for books matching a query, returning a list of Book objects.

methods.name: getBookDetail
methods.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific book, including its chapters.

methods.name: getChapterContent
methods.description: Fetch the content of a specific chapter, utilizing cache for efficiency.

methods.name: requestDownload
methods.description: Initiate a download job for a book in a specified format.

methods.name: getDownloadStatus
methods.description: Check the current status of a download job.

methods.name: pollDownloadStatus
methods.description: Stream that periodically checks download status until completion or error.

methods.name: _sanitizeHtml
methods.description: Internal method to clean up HTML content fetched from backend.
